environment_assessments.name: Rice blast

checks.interpretation: Sample overlap only; not the required five-day mean, sustained wetness or infection assessment.

windows.note: BLASTAM infection-day assessment: wetness duration by temperature during wetness
Required for the previous five-day mean temperature criterion of 20–25 C
Accumulated low temperature over 20 preinfection days (Tohoku method)
Kobayashi et al. 2010: 0–300 degree-days after heading
Alternative window when heading date is unknown
windows.applies_to: Panicle-blast conversion relative to observation date

limitations: Collected reference claims have not all been independently verified.
Three-hourly station air observations do not establish canopy humidity, leaf wetness, continuous duration or infection.
Unresolved growth-stage anchors and incomplete observation windows remain unknown.
environment_assessments.thresholds_text: Wetness requirements: 17 h at 15 C to 10 h at 22–25 C; previous five-day mean 20–25 C (Hiroshima BLASTAM). 20–25 C, at least three rainy days, RH at least 90%, and limited sunshine (RDA, Korea). Panicle infection: 0–300 degree-days after heading (Kobayashi et al., international). Sources: [Hiroshima BLASTAM Table 1](https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/uploaded/attachment/535771.pdf); [RDA 2023-06-15](https://rda.go.kr/board/board.do?mode=view&prgId=day_farmprmninfoEntry&dataNo=100000788240); [Kobayashi et al. 2010](https://www.jppa.or.jp/archive/pdf/64_02_01.pdf)
environment_assessments.evidence_summary: Leaf window source-based; panicle infection window source-based; D-relative conversion inferred
key_weather_variables: Leaf-wetness duration and temperature during wetness
